WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT telescope_count,
         CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM observatory_counts
),
kept AS (
  SELECT telescope_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_share_excess
FROM kept
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Observatories with no telescope records are excluded; starting from every record in telescopes means counting only observatories represented there.
